name: RITES Ltd
title: RITES Ltd - 541556 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Order book hit record INR 9,416 crore with over 50% young, but management guided profits will not break the all-time high this year, with margins diluted by low-margin turnkey and export mix.

triggers.label: Profit record not to be broken FY27
triggers.quote: the profits, while they're aiming to have a growth, but will not be able to break the all-time high records of profit

triggers.label: Order book INR 9,416 crore record
triggers.quote: we ended with the highest-ever order book on 31st March of INR 9,416 crore

triggers.label: Bangladesh export rakes ramp FY27
triggers.quote: the first rake should go in about two months’ time

guidance.value: Aspire to break all-time high revenue in FY27
guidance.quote: break the records of our revenue. All-time high revenue, we will definitely try
the red line of PAT margins 15% and EBITDA margins of 20%, that in no condition will we allow that to be breached

guidance.value: Growth, no record profit in FY27
guidance.quote: profits will grow. To give an exact number is too premature, but profits will grow.

guidance.value: Well above INR 300 crore in FY27
guidance.quote: we are aiming definitely much above the levels of INR 300 crore

red_flags.label: Margin dilution from turnkey and export mix
red_flags.quote: the margins on the new orders are much lower

evasions.quote: it will be premature to peg a real number
